synth.notes:
Crane/skewer: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-+6, carrying blocks overlapping the beam and chain-pushing blocks hit; any pushed block leaving the colour-4 field cancels the whole vertical move (this explains the arm A1 no_change at step 56).
A4/A3 change beam w by 6 within [1, field right]. Any block at x == beam.x+w-5 on the beam rows is hooked, whatever its tag, and drags all fully-on-beam blocks; otherwise extending pushes any block in the swept strip. If the group would leave the field, the beam moves alone (this is the step-87 repair: todo blocks are hooked too).
Tags: a hooked next block becomes collected when every other on-beam block is collected, and the new next is the first todo in legend x order. A collected block that is off the beam reverts to next and the current next goes back to todo. Legend centre 2x2 is 0 while collected. Clicks are no-ops.
